{"consolidated_memory":"## Broken Layout Issues in notifications/email/render.py

A series of five related issues in notifications/email/render.py (notifications side) where a table overflows in the plain text part of the email renderer. All are reproduced by rendering the digest template with a long subject. Each affected a specific population and had a distinct root cause:

### [2026-02-12] Mutable Default Argument Issue
- Trigger: Only accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #1030 on branch fix/broken-layout-1
- Result: Error rate dropped from 1.3 percent to under 4 per 10,000

### [2026-05-01] Serialiser Field Dropping Issue
- Trigger: Only tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #5339 on branch fix/broken-layout-2
- Result: p99 latency fell from 1.1 s to 489 ms

### [2026-05-08] Timezone-Aware Datetime Comparison Issue
- Trigger: Only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #7284 on branch fix/broken-layout-3
- Result: Memory settled at 768 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

### [2026-05-20] N+1 Query Issue
- Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #7957 on branch fix/broken-layout-4
- Result: Throughput rose 55 percent, to 271 requests per second

### [2026-08-02] Bare Except Swallowing Error Issue
- Trigger: Only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: An error swallowed by a bare except clause
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #8698 on branch fix/broken-layout-5
- Result: The alert stayed quiet for 23 consecutive days

All issues manifested in the same corner of the codebase with shared context from earlier broken layout work."}
